name: Alamba - football - alabama university
notes: LEGENDARY college football! Bryant-Denny Stadium (100,077 capacity). "Roll Tide!" National championship tradition!

name: Alamba - football - auburn
notes: SEC Football! Jordan-Hare Stadium (87,451 capacity). "War Eagle!" tradition. Amazing college football atmosphere!

name: Bamahenge, stonehenge copy
notes: Full-scale fiberglass STONEHENGE replica! Free roadside attraction. Hilarious Alabama kitsch. Quick photo stop 15 min.

name: Bates House of Turkey
notes: ALL TURKEY menu! Buffet-style Southern cooking. Turkey and dressing year-round. Quirky concept, popular met locals!

name: BBQ White sauce
notes: FAMOUS White BBQ sauce! World Championship BBQ. Smoked chicken, ribs, pork. Alabama BBQ legend sinds 1925!

name: Botanical Garden
notes: Beautiful gardens + nature trails. Butterfly garden, Japanese garden. Peaceful urban oasis. GRATIS!

name: Bottega - fine dining
notes: Upscale Italian fine dining. Chef Frank Stitt (James Beard winner). Pasta, seafood, seasonal menu. Reservations recommended!

name: Cheaha State Park
notes: HIGHEST point in Alabama (2,407 ft)! Hiking trails, camping, cabins. Talladega National Forest views. Fall foliage spectacular!

name: Chez fox fon - fine dining
notes: French bistro by Chef Frank Stitt. Cozy neighborhood spot. Mussels, steak frites, crème brûlée. Romantic ambiance!

name: FAME Recording Studios
address: 603 E Avalon Ave, Muscle Shoals, AL 35661
notes: Legendary music studio! Aretha Franklin, Wilson Pickett recorded here. "Muscle Shoals sound". Guided tours available!

name: Flora-Bama beach bar
notes: Iconic beach bar on AL/FL state line! Live music, Bushwacker drinks. Oysters, seafood. Beach party atmosphere!

name: Frank Loyd Wrigth -Rosenbaum
notes: Frank Lloyd Wright Usonian home! Only Wright house in Alabama. Guided tours available. Architecture lovers!

name: Gek beelden park
address: 1600 St Bernard Dr SE, Cullman, AL 35055
notes: Jerusalem in Miniature - 125 miniature buildings by monk Brother Joseph. Made of cement, marbles, and toilet seats! 4-acre park. UNIQUE!

name: Gigantische grot
notes: Giant cave - LARGEST cave entrance in the world (126 ft wide). "Goliath" stalagmite 45 ft. Temperature 60°F. 90-min tour. Gem mining. Reservation recommended!

name: Huggin' Molly
notes: Named after a local ghost story. Southern comfort food. Fried catfish, meatloaf, banana pudding. Quirky small-town diner!

name: HydroFest
notes: Powerboat racing festival (July). Hydroplane races on lake. Concerts, fireworks. Fun summer event!

name: Johny's - fine dining
notes: Contemporary Greek-American. Seafood, steaks, pasta. Local Birmingham favorite. Upscale casual!

name: Kerstlichten
notes: Magic Christmas in Lights (late Nov - Dec). 3+ million lights! 65-acre botanical garden. Beautiful Southern estate!

name: Mardi Gras
notes: Mardi Gras history! Mobile had Mardi Gras BEFORE New Orleans. Costumes, floats, traditions. Fun Southern culture!

name: Meerijden met een Nascar
notes: DRIVE a NASCAR stock car! Up to 160+ mph. Ride-along $99 or drive yourself $449+. Fastest NASCAR track. ADRENALINE! Book in advance!

name: Motor park
notes: World's LARGEST motorcycle museum (Guinness)! 1,600+ motorcycles. 880-acre park with racetrack. "Augusta National of Motorsports". IndyCar races!

name: Muscle Shoals Sound Studio
notes: Rolling Stones, Bob Dylan recorded here! Original equipment preserved. Music history tours. Reservations recommended!

name: Natural Bridge
notes: Longest natural bridge east of Rockies! 148ft span, 60ft high. Quiet forest setting. Short easy walk. Peaceful!

name: Natuur en glimwormen
notes: RARE glowworms! Only 3 places in the world. National Natural Landmark. Night tours $10 (Apr-Jul, Sep-Oct). Best: May + Sept. MAGICAL!

name: Old Cahawba spookstad
notes: Alabama's first capital (1820-1826). Abandoned after the Civil War. Ruins, old cemetery, Spanish moss. FREE self-guided tour. Spooky!

name: Peanut stad van USA
notes: Peanut capital of the USA! Annual festival (early November). Carnival rides, concerts, peanut cooking contests. Fun small-town festival!

name: Rattlesnake Saloon
notes: Restaurant UNDER a rock cliff! 7-min horse trail or walk in. Burgers, ribs, catfish. BIZARRE unique setting!

name: Rosa Parks
notes: Civil Rights history. Location of the Rosa Parks bus boycott. Interactive exhibits. Important American history. Moving!

name: SAW's Soul Kitchen
notes: BBQ + Southern soul food. Pulled pork nachos FAMOUS! Mac and cheese, collards. Casual, no-frills, delicious!

name: Selma Bridge
notes: Civil Rights landmark. 1965 "Bloody Sunday" march. National Historic Landmark. Powerful American history. GRATIS!

name: Shrimp festival 8-11 october
address: 101 Gulf Shores Pkwy, Gulf Shores, AL 36542
notes: Jaarlijks festival (early October). 200+ arts/crafts vendors. Live music, shrimp cooking. Gulf Coast beaches nearby. GRATIS!

name: Sloss Furnaces, oude staalfabrieken
notes: Former iron smelter (1882-1971). National Historic Landmark. Industrial archaeology. "Most haunted in Alabama". FREE!

name: Space Camp
notes: NASA's official center! ADULT Space Camp - astronaut training. Saturn V rocket, Apollo capsules. Smithsonian-affiliated. 3-6 day program!

name: Special ribs
notes: LEGENDARY ribs since 1958! "Ain't nothin' like 'em nowhere!" Hickory-smoked perfection. Alabama BBQ institution. Iconic!

name: Stephens Gap Callahan Cave
notes: 143ft waterfall INSIDE cave! Spectacular pit cave. Rappelling/caving experience required. FREE but dangerous - for experienced cavers!

name: Unclaimed Baggage Center
notes: THE ONLY store for unclaimed airplane baggage in America! 50,000 sq ft full of lost treasures. Museum of Found Treasures with Labyrinth puppets. Cups Café. FREE admission!

name: Alaska Raptor Center
notes: BALD eagle rehabilitation!  Birds of Prey Center.  Education + conservation.  Shuttle available.  WILDLIFE rescue!

name: Alaska Salmon Bake
notes: ALL-YOU-CAN-EAT salmon!  Alaskan king crab.  Outdoor seating.  Buffet style.  TOURISTY but tasty!

name: Alaska Wildlife Viewing
notes: BALD eagles everywhere!  32,000 in Juneau alone.  Black/brown bears.  Moose, caribou.  WILDLIFE paradise!

name: Alaskan King Crab Feast
notes: CRAB feast experience!  All you can eat.  Senic location.  Boat ride included.  SPLURGE meal!

name: Creek Street Ketchikan
notes: HISTORIC red light district!  Buildings on stilts.  Salmon ladder (watch spawning!).  Dolly's House Museum $10.  COLORFUL boardwalk!

name: Denali Backcountry Lodge
address: Mile 92 Denali Park Rd, Kantishna, AK
notes: DEEP in park!  Mile 92 location.  All-inclusive lodge.  June early season rates.  REMOTE luxury!

name: Denali Cabins
notes: Budget base camp!  Whitewater rafting nearby.  ATV, zipline tours.  June deals.  ACTIVITY hub!

name: Denali Flightseeing
notes: FLY around Mt. Denali!  Glacier landing option.  20,310ft peak views.  Weather dependent.  ONCE-IN-LIFETIME!

name: Denali Park Bus Tour
notes: Tundra Wilderness Tour!  7-8hrs to Mile 62.  Wildlife spotting.  Naturalist guide.  MUST DO Denali!

name: Denali Sled Dog Kennels
notes: WORKING sled dogs!  Demonstrations daily.  100 years tradition.  Meet puppies!  FREE show!

name: Denali Visitor Center
notes: 20-minute movie Denali!  Exhibits, fossils.  Ranger programs.  Bookstore.  START here!

name: Dewey Lake Trail
notes: Easy 1-2hr hike!  Lower Dewey Lake.  Forest trails.  Walkable from dock.  FREE hiking!

name: Fortress of the Bear
notes: ORPHANED bear sanctuary!  Brown bears close up.  Educational tours.  Taxi from port.  BEAR rescue center!

name: Glacier Bay Cruise-By
notes: SHIP cruises through park!  No dock, scenic cruising.  Marjorie Glacier views.  Whales, bears.  INCLUDED in cruise!

name: Great Alaskan Lumberjack Show
notes: LUMBERJACK competition!  Ax throwing, log rolling.  Chainsaw carving.  1hr show.  FUN + kitsch!

name: Helicopter Dog Sledding Juneau
notes: BUCKET LIST excursion!  Helicopter to glacier.  Dog sled ride.  Measure puppies.  3hrs total.  EXPENSIVE but EPIC!

name: Hoonah Native Village
notes: TLINGIT culture!  Story telling, dance.  Traditional crafts.  Less touristy.  AUTHENTIC Alaska!

name: Klondike Doughboy (Elephant Ears)
notes: FAMOUS fried dough!  Massive elephant ears.  Share between 2-3.  Budget tip: DON'T skip!  DELICIOUS!

name: Mendenhall Glacier
notes: ICONIC glacier 12 miles from port!  Visitor center + trails.  Budget tip: City bus $2 each way.  Or walk/Uber vs cruise excursion.  EASY DIY access!

name: Midnight Sun June Experience
notes: JUNE = 20 hours of daylight!  Sunset around midnight.  Photography magic.  No need for sleep!  UNIQUE phenomenon!

name: Misty Fjords Flightseeing
notes: GLACIER-CARVED wilderness!  3,000ft cliffs.  Waterfalls, blue lakes.  Floatplane tour 2hrs.  BREATHTAKING!

name: Mount Healy Overlook Trail
notes: CHALLENGING hike!  2.7 miles, 1,700ft climb.  Viewpoint above treeline.  May see Denali peak.  REWARDING views!

name: Mount Roberts Tramway
notes: Gondola to 1,800ft viewpoint!  Hiking trails at the top.  Restaurant + gift shop.  5-minute walk from cruise dock.  SCENIC views!

name: Savage River Trail
notes: EASY 2-mile run!  River views.  Flat trail.  All fitness levels.  Check out bear closures!

name: Saxman Native Village
notes: Totem carving demos!  Cultural dance performances.  Tlingit storytelling.  2.5 miles from port.  CULTURAL immersion!

name: Sitka National Historical Park
notes: TOTEM POLE trail!  Tlingit + Russian history.  Rainforest walk.  2 miles from port.  FREE National Park!

name: Skagway Brewing Company
notes: Spruce Tip Blonde Ale!  Local brewery.  Food available.  Walk from dock.  CRAFT bear Alaska!

name: Skagway Downtown
notes: 900 inhabitants!  Gold Rush architecture.  Klondike Gold Rush Park.  Red Onion Saloon.  WALKABLE + charming!

name: Totem Heritage Center
notes: LARGEST collection unrestored totems!  33 original 19th century poles.  Tlingit + Haida culture.  Shuttle from port.  AUTHENTIC!

name: Tracy Arm Fjord Excursion
notes: FJORD cruise!  Sawyer Glaciers.  Icebergs, waterfalls.  7-9hrs full day.  SCENIC alternative!

name: Whale Watching Icy Strait
address: Icy Strait Point Harbor, Hoonah, AK 99829
notes: Point Adolphus whales!  Humpback feeding.  Orcas, sea lions.  Less crowds.  EXCELLENT viewing!

name: Whale Watching Juneau
notes: HUMPBACK whales guaranteed!  Bubble net feeding.  Orcas, sea lions.  2-3hr tours.  BEST whale watching in Alaska!

name: White Pass & Yukon Railway
notes: ICONIC train ride!  Gold Rush Trail of '98.  White Pass Summit 2,865ft.  3hrs round trip.  MUST DO Skagway!

name: Yukon Bus Tour
notes: DESERT in the mountains!  Carcross Desert.  Emerald Lake.  Terrain changes wildly.  Sit RIGHT side!  STUNNING drive!

name: ZipRider Icy Strait
notes: LONGEST zip line North America!  5,495ft long.  1,300ft drop.  60+ mph speed.  THRILLING ride!

name: Atlas Coal Mine National Historic Site
address: 110 Century Coal Road, East Coulee, AB T0J 1B0
notes: Canada's last intact coal tipple - UNESCO application! Tours of the processing plant. Miners' stories. East Coulée, near Drumheller. May-October. Walk through the industrial ruins. Badlands backdrop = cinematic setting.

name: Banff Ave Brewing Co.
notes: Craft brewery right on Banff Avenue - the most popular beer spot! Mountain Lakes IPA + Rocky Mountain Honey Wheat. Large terrace. Local atmosphere. Banff town centre. Happy Hour: best deal in town. Having a pint here after a walk is the perfect day.

name: Banff Helicopter Tours
notes: Helicopter over the Canadian Rockies - glacier perspective! Lake Louise, Moraine Lake, Columbia Icefield from above. Banff + Canmore area operators. Various flights: 20-60 minutes. Sunrise flight = ultimate Canada content for @roamingbonbons.

name: Banff Merman - Banff Indian Trading Post
notes: Half-human, half-fish taxidermy creation from 1915! Norman Luxton's mysterious creation. Probably ape + mackerel. Banff Indian Trading Post, Cave Avenue. FREE to view from the shop. The strangest thing in an otherwise beautiful little town.

name: Banff National Park - Bears/Wildlife
notes: Grizzly + black bear, moose, bighorn sheep ALONG THE ROAD! Wildlife crossings over Trans-Canada Highway: scientific wonder. Banff townsite: moose walking through streets in the morning. Parks Canada pass. Always keep your windows closed. Really.

name: Banff Sunshine Village ⛷️ Ikon Ski Big 3
notes: Ikon Pass: 7 TOTAL DAYS shared with Lake Louise + Mt Norquay (Ski Big 3). UNESCO World Heritage ski IN Banff National Park! Gondola to the village - surreally beautiful. Els: Strawberry/Meadow Park = good beginner zones. Serge: Delirium Dive at extreme powder = legendary (extreme terrain). 2+ days recommended here. Combine with Lake Louise on the same Ikon budget!

name: Banff Upper Hot Springs
notes: Geothermal pool at an altitude of 1,585m with mountain views! Mountain water at 37-40°C. Goldbug style but official. Banff center. Open all year round. Tours Canada Parks pass covers the surrounding area; springs themselves are separate. Après-ski + nature combo. Popular but worth it.

name: Big Valley Badlands + Dry Island Buffalo Jump
address: Dry Island Buffalo Jump, AB T0M 0J0
notes: Lesser-known alternative to Drumheller – almost without tourists! Buffaloes were driven off cliffs here by Indigenous hunters. Big Valley, Red Deer River badlands. America the Beautiful NOT valid - Alberta Parks pass. Autumn: colors in the badlands are spectacular.

name: Calgary Stampede
address: 1410 Olympic Way SE, Calgary, AB T2G 2W1
notes: 'Greatest Outdoor Show on Earth' - 10 days in July! Rodeo, chuckwagon races, live music, midway, Blackfoot greeting. Calgary, first week + weekend of July. 1912 - over 100 years of tradition. If the timing is right (not on the route in 2027 but...): unforgettable.

name: Canmore centrum B&B / boutique
notes: Canmore = cheaper base than Banff with the same mountain view! 15 minutes from Banff Gate. Local atmosphere. Many boutique B&Bs and small hotels. Canmore is a real town with local restaurants. Best value for money for a Banff NP visit.

name: Club Rendezvous - Calgary
notes: Canada's longest-running lifestyle club - upscale on-premise events! Theme nights: Bondage, Fetish Friday, speed dating. $10/month membership. Canada's cheapest quality club. Calgary. Edmonton opening soon. Sign up via website.

name: Columbia Icefield + Glacier Experience
notes: The only place where you are allowed to drive on a GLACIER (Ice Explorer)! Athabasca Glacier: 300m thick. Unfortunately, it is melting. Columbia Icefield: the most accessible ice field in the world. Halfway along Icefields Parkway. SkyWalk: glass floor bridge over the canyon. Dizzying.

name: Drumheller Hoodoos
notes: Erosion pillars (hoodoos) 5-7m high in the middle of the badlands! Millions of years of sandstone erosion. An absolute lunar landscape. Hoodoo Trail, 18 km from Drumheller. FREE. Hiking trail along the peaks. Spring + autumn: soft light. Summer: extremely hot.

name: Fairmont Banff Springs Hotel
notes: Castle in the Rockies' - legendary 1888 chateau hotel! Golf course + spa + multiple restaurants + bowling alley. Banff National Park. High season: extremely expensive, but the experience is unique. A night here feels like surviving in a fairytale.

name: Icefield Skywalk + Athabasca Glacier Walk
notes: Glass-floor balcony 280m above the Sunwapta Valley! Athabasca Glacier Ice Explorer (special vehicles on the ice). Halfway along Icefields Parkway. Parks Canada Pass + Skywalk ticket sold separately. You simply have to do this on the Parkway.

name: Icefields Parkway - Banff naar Jasper
notes: MOST BEAUTIFUL drive in the world - 232 km through the Canadian Rockies! Glacier peaks, turquoise lakes, waterfalls, moose. Columbia Icefield halfway: glacier drive available. Parks Canada pass required ($25 USD/day). June-Sept: best driving season. Book Jasper accommodation MONTHS in advance!

name: Jasper National Park - Dark Sky Preserve
notes: World's third largest Dark Sky Preserve! Milky Way visible with the naked eye. No light pollution. Jasper National Park. Summer nights + autumn. Parks Canada Pass. Combine with the Icefields Parkway drive for a perfect Alberta day.

name: KNetic Club - Calgary
notes: Calgary's largest lifestyle club - nightclub-style with private rooms! Kinky yoga, rope play, ladies' nights. Membership required. Calgary. One of Canada's top-rated clubs. Pre-approval profile required.

name: Lake Louise - Fairmont
notes: Canada's most photographed lake - turquoise glacial lake! Victorian Glacier reflection in the water. Green-blue. Fairmont Chateau Louise on the shore. Banff National Park. Parks Canada pass. Sunrise: absolutely magical. Set your alarm for 5 am.

name: Lake Louise Ski Resort ⛷️ Ikon Ski Big 3
address: 1 Whitehorn Rd, Lake Louise, AB T0L 1E0
notes: Ikon Pass: shared 7 DAYS with Ski Big 3. LARGEST ski area in Alberta (4 mountain sides!). Top = INCREDIBLE view over frozen Lake Louise. Wind at the top can be rough. After skiing: visit the frozen Lake Louise ice sculpture festival in winter = MAGICAL for the vlog! Els: Front Face is accessible. Serge: Ptarmigan + Back Bowls = expert paradise.

name: Maple Leaf Grille & Spirits - Banff
notes: Canadiana cuisine: bison, caribou, Alberta beef, Okanagan wine! Carved oak decor. Classic Canadian feel. Banff Avenue. The 3-course deal was a great deal in the low season. Perfect after a visit to Banff Upper Hot Springs.

name: Miette Hot Springs - Jasper
address: Miette Hot Springs Rd, Jasper, AB T0E 1E0
notes: Hottest pool springs in the Canadian Rockies (54°C cooled down to 40°C)! Jasper National Park. Remote drives through mountainous terrain. 61 km from Jasper townsite. Less crowded than Banff. May-October. Goldbug style but more comfortable. Highly recommended.

name: Moraine Lake - Valley of Ten Peaks
address: Moraine Lake Rd, Lake Louise, AB T0L 1E0
notes: Once on the Canadian $20 bill! Ten mountain peaks as a backdrop. Then turquoise Lake Louise. INCREDIBLE. Moraine Lake Rd closed to cars: shuttle or bike (reserve!) Banff NP. Parks Canada pass. Sunrise boat tour: book weeks in advance.

name: Mt. Norquay ⛷️ Ikon Ski Big 3
address: 2 Mt Norquay Rd, Banff, AB T1L 1B4
notes: Ikon Pass: shared 7 DAYS with Ski Big 3. MOST beginner-friendly of the three! Smallest but perfect practice/rest day for Els. Spectacular views over Banff town. Only 5 min from Banff centre - closest and easiest. Ideal as a mid-day break day between Sunshine and Louise. Normally NO separate Ikon reservation needed. Summer: Via Ferrata via Norquay!

name: River Café - Calgary
address: Prince's Island Park, Calgary, AB T2P 0R1
notes: Award-winning farm-to-table dining on an island in the Bow River! Prince's Island Park. Seasonal menu. Local Canadian. Calgary's best fine dining garden restaurant. Accessible via a footbridge over the river. Book well in advance. Special in every season.

name: Royal Tyrrell Museum - Drumheller
notes: Largest dinosaur fossil collection in the world - 40+ complete skeletons! In the middle of the Badlands. View our own excavations. Drumheller. May-Oct: daily. Nov-Apr: closed Tuesdays. A museum where you forget you are a museum.

name: Sky Bistro - Banff Gondola Top
notes: Dining at 2,200m above the Rocky Mountains! Gondola up, 360° panorama, menu with Canadian products. Banff Gondola top, Sulphur Mountain. Book gondola + restaurant together. Sunset here = a religious experience.

name: Sunny Chinooks Camping Association - Sundre
notes: Alberta's best naturist campground – since 1952! 1.5 hours NW of Calgary near Sundre. Clubhouse, showers, RV sites, hot tub. Family-friendly (naturist convention). May through September. Call ahead for first visit.

name: The Bison Restaurant - Banff
notes: Seasonal Canadian restaurant in a historic building! Alberta bison, local vegetables, mountain herbs. Banff downtown, Bear Street. Set menu: 3-course $39 CAD was a great deal. One of Banff's absolute best. Make a reservation.

name: Three Bears Brewery & Restaurant - Banff
notes: Craft brewery IN a national park - with a retractable starry roof! 25-foot pine tree + forest animal decor inside. Banff's most unique restaurant concept. House beers + Alberta steak + pizza. Retractable roof: summer dining under the stars.

name: UFO Landing Pad - St. Paul
notes: OFFICIAL alien landing pad built in 1967! Canada's 100th anniversary project. Really meant seriously. St. Paul, E-Alberta. Visitor center underneath. FREE. Local pride = 100% genuine. EBU official. Aliens are welcome. Really.

name: Wayne Ghost Town + Last Chance Saloon
notes: Ghost town with 11 bridge crossings to get there! Last Chance Saloon: bullet holes in the walls + historical photos. Wayne: former mining town, now ~30 residents. 9 km from Drumheller. Star Mine Suspension Bridge nearby. Have a beer with ghosts in the Saloon. Mandatory.

name: West Edmonton Mall
notes: Largest mall in the world (formerly) - own indoor sea + amusement park + hotel! Wave machine, penguins, ice rink, rollercoaster. Everything indoors. Edmonton. Water Park, Ice Palace, Europa Boulevard. Kids going wild. Adults too, to be honest.

name: World's Largest Dinosaur - Drumheller
notes: 26-meter-tall T-Rex (4x bigger than the real thing!) - Climbing 'Tyra' is MANDATORY! 106 steps up. View of the badlands from the mouth. Drumheller = Dinosaur Valley. The badlands are surreal. FREE to view from the outside. Climbing = $5 CAD. The most bizarre skyline in Canada.

name: Apache Trail
notes: SPECTACULAR scenic drive!  120 miles Apache Junction to Roosevelt.  Superstition Mountains.  Canyon Lake, Tortilla Flat.  Gravel road partially!

name: Arcosantie Hippie town
address: 13555 S Cross L Rd, Mayer, AZ 86333
notes: Paolo Soleri's arcology experiment! Architecture + ecology. Brutalist concrete city since 1970. Bronze bells for sale. Guided tours Thu-Mon!

name: Bearizona Wildlife Park
notes: Drive-through wildlife park! Bears, wolves, and bison right from your car. Walk-through Cub Kingdom. 160 acres. 3-mile scenic drive. Exceptionally close to the animals!

name: Chiricahua National Monument
notes: Land of Standing-Up Rocks!  Bizarre hoodoos + balanced rocks.  Volcanic.  17-mile scenic drive.  Hiking trails galore!

name: Cliff Dwellings
notes: Ancient Puebloan ruins!  800+ ruins in canyon.  Spider Rock view.  Need Navajo guide for canyon floor.  Rim drives FREE!

name: Dinosaur tracks
notes: 200 million year old dinosaur tracks! Navajo Nation land. Dilophosaurus footprints. Local guides available. FREE but tip expected!

name: Failed Mars experiment
notes: Failed 1990s ecosystem experiment!  5 biomes under glass.  Rainforest, ocean, desert.  University of Arizona research.  1.5 hour self-guided app tour!

name: Four Corners
address: Four Corners Monument, Teec Nos Pos, AZ
notes: THE ONLY place with 4 states at once! AZ-UT-CO-NM. Navajo Nation. Vendor stalls. Touristy but iconic!

name: Ghost town, kunstenaars
notes: Wickedest Town in the West! Copper mining 1876–1953. Now an artists' community. Wineries (Maynard of Tool!). Ghost tours + galleries!

name: Hotel
notes: Luxury boutique Sedona hotel!  12 rooms hacienda style.  Save rock views.  Pet friendly.  Romantic high end!

name: Hotel luchthaven
notes: Hotel on top of the mesa! Private airfield. Panoramic red rock views. Cabins + rooms. Unique location!

name: Kartchner Caverns
notes: LIVING cave! 2.4 miles of underground passages. Massive formations. Discovered 1974, opened 1999. Guided tours ONLY!

name: Meteor Crater
notes: BEST preserved meteor crater! 550 ft deep, 4,000 ft wide. 50,000 years old. Apollo astronauts trained here. Rim tours + museum!

name: Montezuma Castle
notes: Cliff dwellings 1100-1425 AD!  5-story apartment in limestone cliff.  Sinagua people.  20 rooms.  WELL preserved!

name: Muziek museum
notes: Musical Instrument Museum! 15,000+ instruments worldwide. Geographic galleries. Experience Gallery - play yourself! Incredible collection!

name: Mystery Castle
notes: Father built a castle for his daughter! 18 rooms made from found materials. Car parts, gold mining tools. Bizarre architecture. Oct-June ONLY!

name: Nucleare site te bezoeken
address: 1580 W Duval Mine Rd, Sahuarita, AZ 85629
notes: THE ONLY accessible Titan II silo! 110ft missile still intact. Cold War relic. Simulated launch experience. 55 steps down!

name: Openlucht Museum vliegtuigen
notes: LARGEST aviation museum! 400+ aircraft. 80 acres. SR-71, B-29, Presidential planes. Boneyard bus tours extra!

name: Organ pizza restaurant
notes: Pizza + Wurlitzer organ show! 4/73 Mighty Wurlitzer. Organist plays while you eat. BIZARRE experience. Vintage arcade games!

name: Overnachten in de woestijn
notes: Joshua Tree House in Sonoran Desert!  Glamping experience.  Off-grid but luxurious.  Stargazing perfection.  Unique desert stay!

name: Petrified Forest
notes: Petrified trees 225 million years ago! Painted Desert views. Route 66 historic sites. 28-mile scenic drive. Badlands + petroglyphs!

name: Raptor Ranch & Bedrock City
notes: Birds of Prey + Flintstones Bedrock City!  Eagles, hawks, owls close up.  40+ rescued birds.  Flintstones theme.  BIZARRE combination!

name: Red Rock
address: 4050 Red Rock Loop Rd, Sedona, AZ 86336
notes: Red Rock State Park! Oak Creek running through the park. Hiking trails + bird watching. Sedona red rocks without the crowds. Nature center!

name: Rotsen vergelijkbaar Wave
notes: LIKE The Wave but NO permit!  Swirling white/red sandstone.  4WD REQUIRED rough road.  Vermilion Cliffs.  Less crowded than Wave!

name: Scottsdale
notes: Luxury desert city!  Old Town galleries.  Frank Lloyd Wright Taliesin West.  Spas, golf, shopping.  Upscale Phoenix suburb!

name: Slapen in originele trailer
notes: Vintage trailer park hotel! 1950s Airstreams + caravans. Each with a theme. Chris Craft yacht! Unique retro experience!

name: The Thing
notes: Mystery of the Desert!  247 billboards advertise this thing.  $5 for aliens vs dinosaurs backstory.  Mummy mother & child.  Dairy Queen on site!

name: Tombstone
notes: The Town Too Tough to Die!  OK Corral gunfight reenactment.  Bird Cage Theatre.  Boot Hill Cemetery.  Wild West kitsch perfection!

name: Tortilla saloon
notes: Smallest town in AZ!  Population: 6. Old West saloon on Apache Trail.  Prickly pear ice cream!  Walls covered in $1 bills!

name: Crater of Diamonds State Park
notes: DIG FOR DIAMONDS! The only public diamond mine! Keep what you find! 75,000+ diamonds found. 40-acre plowed field. GOLD!

name: Crescent Ghost hotel
notes: “America's Most Haunted Hotel!”  Ghost tours daily.  Historic 1886 castle.  Victorian architecture.  Eureka Springs. SPOOKY!

name: Crystal Bridges Museum of American Art
notes: WORLD CLASS art museum!  Walmart-funded.  Frank Lloyd Wright house.  Sculpture trails.  FREE admission. STUNNING!

name: Devil's Den State Park
notes: OZARK hiking paradise!  Caves, bluffs, waterfalls.  CCC built cabins.  Butterfield Trail.  Fall foliage spectacular!

name: Esse Purse Museum
notes: PURSE through time!  1900s-current handbags.  Women's history through accessories.  Quirky + educational.  Little Rock treasure!

name: Fordyce Bathhouse
notes: Bathhouse Row MUSEUM!  Most beautiful bathhouse (1915).  FREE self-guided tour.  Original tiled pools, equipment.  National Park Service. MUST!

name: Gangster Museum of America
notes: Al Capone vacation spot!  Gangster history Hot Springs.  1920s-30s organized crime.  Interactive exhibits.  MAFIA vibes!

name: Grotto Wood-Fired Grill and Wine Cave
notes: WINE CAVE restaurant!  Underground dining.  Wood fired grill.  Extensive wine list.  Eureka Springs. ROMANTIC!

name: Hotsprings bath
notes: OLDEST working bathhouse (1912)! Traditional thermal baths. 102°F mineral water. Sitz baths, steam cabinets. Separate men's and women's areas. UNIQUE!

name: Jones Bar-B-Q Diner
notes: OLDEST Black owned restaurant USA!  James Beard Award.  Oldest BBQ in Arkansas (1910)!  Cash only, simple menu.  HISTORIC + delicious!

name: Lodge wildpark
address: 239 Turpentine Creek Ln, Eureka Springs, AR 72631
notes: SLEEPING with big cats! Lodges at the sanctuary. Tiger roar as an alarm clock. Unique experience. Animal lovers' paradise!

name: McCLARD'S BAR-B-Q
notes: LEGENDARY BBQ since 1928!  Bill Clinton favorite.  Ribs, goat BBQ (unique!).  Secret sauce.  ARKANSAS institution!

name: Petit Jean State Park
address: 1285 Petit Jean Mountain Rd, Morrilton, AR 72110
notes: Arkansas's FIRST state park!  Cedar Falls 95ft waterfall.  Rock House Cave.  Mather Lodge.  Scenic overlooks. CLASSIC!

name: Superior Bathhouse Brewery
notes: THE ONLY brewery in the National Park! Beer brewed with thermal water. Historic bathhouse building. Tour + tasting. QUIRKY concept!

name: The Old Mill
address: 3800 Lakeshore Dr, North Little Rock, AR 72116
notes: Gone with the Wind opening scene!  1933 replica mill.  Photogenic park.  T.R. Pugh Memorial Park.  FREE. Movie history!

name: Treehouse
address: 165 W Van Buren, Eureka Springs, AR 72632
notes: TREEHOUSE cottages!  14 themed treehouses.  Romantic + quirky.  Hot tubs.  Eureka Springs hideaway. MAGICAL!

name: Turpentine Creek Wildlife Refuge
address: 239 Turpentine Creek Ln, Eureka Springs, AR 72631
notes: BIG CAT sanctuary!  Tigers, lions, leopards rescued.  450-acre refuge.  Guided tours.  Lodges available. ROAR!

name: Walmart Museum
notes: Original Walmart #1 (1950)!  Sam Walton's 5&10.  Retail history.  Spark Café inside.  FREE. Corporate pilgrimage!

name: White Water Tavern
notes: LIVE music venue!  Indie bands, local artists.  Dive bar atmosphere.  Little Rock nightlife.  Music lovers!

name: Abbaye d'Orval
notes: Historic Trappist abbey with stunning ruins and a working brewery producing the legendary Orval beer. It offers peaceful grounds and beautiful architecture perfect for a relaxing afternoon. There are nearby camping options and scenic Ardennes biking paths.

name: Adventure Valley Durbuy
notes: Choose among treetop courses, via ferrata, tubing, mountain biking and other activities rather than buying into a one-size-fits-all day. Reserve the most suitable pass, then combine the park with Durbuy's old centre or a campsite along the Ourthe.

name: Athena Helios
notes: This established naturist campsite offers tent pitches, swimming and recreation in a wooded setting near Leuven and Brussels. Contact the resort before arrival to confirm membership or visitor-card requirements, day access and whether the F-150 fits the assigned pitch.

name: Athena Le Rêve
address: Rue de la Carrière 12, 4170 Comblain-au-Pont, Wallonia
notes: A tranquil naturist camping site situated in a beautifully secluded quarry setting in the Ardennes. It offers great facilities for tent campers who prefer a clothing-optional environment. The surrounding region is renowned for scenic river valleys and hiking paths.

name: Atomium
notes: Originally built for the 1958 Brussels World's Fair, this massive iron crystal structure is a retro-futuristic marvel. Visitors can take escalators through the tubes and enjoy panoramic views of Brussels from the top sphere. A uniquely Belgian landmark that bridges history and weird science.

name: Bastogne War Museum
notes: An immersive museum dedicated to the Battle of the Bulge with interactive, personal perspectives. It provides deep historical context which the couple will appreciate for its quality and scale. The massive Mardasson Memorial is right next door.

name: Bokrijk Open-Air Museum
notes: Historic buildings, demonstrations and large green grounds create a lived-in landscape rather than a conventional indoor museum. Plan at least half a day and bring the e-bikes for Cycling Through Water and the De Wijers ponds next door.

name: Brouwerij Het Anker
notes: One of Belgium's oldest operating breweries, famous for the Gouden Carolus beer. The guided tour concludes with a generous tasting and excellent insights into Belgian brewing traditions. Mechelen is very bike-friendly and has a great historic center.

name: C-mine
notes: A brilliantly restored coal mining site transformed into a cultural hub. The expedition tour takes you underground through ventilation shafts and up the towering headframes for amazing views. A fascinating blend of industrial heritage and modern design.

name: Cantillon Brewery
notes: This working lambic brewery retains wooden equipment, open fermentation and atmospheric ageing rooms. Reserve an English tour, use public transport rather than driving the F-150 into Brussels and combine it with the Marolles or a gueuze-focused meal.

name: Caves of Han
notes: A historic tram and guided route lead through enormous limestone chambers, with an optional wildlife park and treetop experience. Allow most of a day, pack a light layer for the cool cave and reserve ahead during weekends and school holidays.

name: Château de Vêves
notes: A spectacular fairytale-like castle with pointed turrets perched on a rocky peak. It feels incredibly authentic and offers a glimpse into medieval life in the region. It is situated close to Dinant and beautiful forested cycling routes.

name: Choco-Story Brussels
notes: A highly interactive museum dedicated to the history and production of chocolate. It features live demonstrations by master chocolatiers and plenty of tasting opportunities. It is an indulgent and fun cultural stop in the heart of the capital.

name: Citadel of Dinant
address: Chemin de la Citadelle 1, 5500 Dinant, Wallonia
notes: Perched high on a cliff overlooking the Meuse River, offering spectacular views and rich military history. Visitors can reach it via a steep staircase or a convenient cable car. The surrounding valley is excellent for scenic e-bike rides.

name: Cycling Through Heathland
notes: This four-kilometre national-park section includes a 300-metre wooden bridge with panoramic heathland views. Late summer gives the best purple heather, but the ride works year-round and combines naturally with Terhills or a longer Limburg cycling loop.

name: Cycling Through Trees
notes: A circular elevated path climbs gradually to ten metres among the pines of Bosland National Park. Free parking and the surrounding cycle-node network make it easy to build a 30- to 60-kilometre e-bike loop without technical riding.

name: Cycling Through Water
notes: A sunken 200-metre cycle path crosses a pond with the water surface at eye level on both sides. Link it into a longer De Wijers loop, then visit Bokrijk; the route is also open to walkers and joggers.

name: De Halve Maan Brewery
notes: This family brewery explains Bruges' underground beer pipeline and finishes the standard tour with a tasting. The route includes steep stairs, so wear practical shoes and leave the truck at a park-and-ride before walking or cycling into the centre.

name: De Schorre Troll Forest
notes: Seven giant recycled-wood trolls are hidden around the former clay-pit landscape used by Tomorrowland. Explore on foot or bike, expect muddy paths after rain and check event closures before arriving with the truck.

name: Doel
notes: This partly abandoned but still inhabited village mixes street art, empty houses, a windmill and immense port infrastructure. Stay on public roads, respect residents and current access restrictions, and combine it with the Verbeke Foundation or Fort Liefkenshoek.

name: Fondry des Chiens
notes: This protected limestone chasm resembles a miniature canyon and is reached by a scenic walk from Nismes. The 4.4-kilometre route is a good active stop, and the village has motorhome facilities and easy links to the Viroin valley.

name: Fort Breendonk
notes: This preserved fort and former Nazi detention camp is one of Belgium's most confronting historical sites. Allow at least two hours and avoid stacking too many heavy memorial visits on the same day; De Schorre and Mechelen are nearby.

name: Furfooz Nature Reserve
address: Rue du Camp Romain 79, 5500 Furfooz, Namur
notes: A marked 3.5-kilometre trail links cliffs, caves, Roman remains and viewpoints over the Lesse. It is compact but steep enough to feel adventurous; check for flood-related closures and combine it with Dinant or kayaking on the Lesse.

name: Ghent Festivities
notes: For ten days in July, central Ghent becomes a huge mostly free festival of music, street theatre, food and late-night crowds. Stay at a campsite or hotel outside the centre and use bikes, trams or trains; weekday afternoons are lively without maximum chaos.

name: Gravensteen
notes: Explore a medieval castle complete with a moat right in the center of Ghent. Provides a fascinating audio guide with a humorous twist perfect for an engaging visit. Great for combining with a walking or biking tour of the historic city center.

name: Grotten van Kanne
notes: An extensive network of marl caves featuring impressive mural paintings and even an underground mushroom farm. It provides a highly unique guided tour exploring local history and geology. The constant cool temperature makes it a great rainy day activity.

name: Grottes de Remouchamps
notes: These stunning caves offer the longest underground boat ride in the world alongside impressive stalactite formations. The dual experience of walking through the caverns and taking a boat back is highly memorable. Located in the Ardennes, ideal for a road trip stop.

name: Hallerbos
notes: This ancient forest becomes a blue-purple carpet during the short bluebell season, usually in April. Visit very early or arrive by bike or shuttle because parking fills quickly, and remain on marked paths to protect the flowers.

name: High Fens and Botrange
notes: Belgium's highest plateau offers peat bogs, forest trails and exposed boardwalk walks with a genuinely wild feel. Weather can turn quickly, so bring waterproof layers and check trail closures; combine it with the Vennbahn, Malmedy or a legal campsite around Bütgenbach.

name: Hoge Kempen National Park
notes: Belgium's largest national park combines heathland, pine forest, mining heritage and extensive hiking and cycling networks. Start at the visitor centre, unload the foldable e-bikes and use designated campsites because wild camping is generally not permitted; the U.S. National Parks pass is not valid here.

name: In Flanders Fields Museum
notes: This modern museum inside the Cloth Hall explains the First World War through personal stories and regional context. Combine it with the evening Last Post and a battlefield cycling loop, leaving the oversized truck at a peripheral car park.

name: Kalmthoutse Heide
notes: A stunning cross-border nature reserve featuring heathlands, sand dunes, and pine forests. Perfect for the couple to use their e-bikes or hike along well-marked trails. It presents a very different side of Belgian nature compared to the Ardennes.

name: Lieteberg Barefoot Path
notes: A nearly 3km trail designed specifically to be walked entirely barefoot over wood, stones, water, and mud. It is a wonderfully quirky way to experience nature and get grounded. Afterwards, visitors can enjoy the on-site insect museum and butterfly greenhouse.

name: Lommel Sahara
notes: A striking landscape of sand dunes, pine forests, and bright blue lakes born from historical sand extraction. The area boasts excellent cycling paths and a tall observation tower offering panoramic views. An ideal spot for the couple to enjoy a nature-filled day.

name: Meise Botanic Garden
notes: One of the largest botanical gardens in the world, featuring historic glasshouses and a massive collection of rare plants. The spacious grounds are fantastic for walking and include a picturesque 12th-century castle. A peaceful escape situated just outside the Brussels ring.

name: Middelheim Museum
notes: A vast open-air sculpture park featuring modern and contemporary art scattered throughout lush green lawns. Completely free to enter, it offers a fantastic place for a leisurely walk or bike ride. An unexpected cultural gem just outside the city center.

name: Molignée Railbikes
address: Rue de la Molignée 116, 5537 Warnant, Namur
notes: Pedal a four-person railbike along a disused railway through the wooded Molignée valley. The activity is active without being extreme, departure times are fixed, and the longer route combines well with Maredsous Abbey or Montaigle Castle.

name: Ninglinspo Valley
notes: This energetic riverside hike follows Belgium's only mountain stream past cascades, rocks and small pools. Choose the longer Ninglinspo-Chefna loop for a proper workout, wear grippy footwear and combine it with the Fonds de Quarreux or Remouchamps.

name: Nuetnigenough
notes: A cozy, authentic Belgian brasserie specializing in hearty local cuisine paired with an exceptional selection of craft beers. The name translates to never enough, which applies perfectly to their rich stews. It gets busy, so arriving early is a must.

name: Pairi Daiza
notes: This vast landscaped animal park is organised as immersive themed worlds, making the gardens and architecture nearly as important as the animals. Arrive at opening, expect a full day of walking and book online during busy periods; camping options are available elsewhere in the region.

name: Plantin-Moretus Museum
notes: A UNESCO World Heritage site featuring the two oldest surviving printing presses in the world. Walking through the 16th-century home and workshops feels like stepping back in time. It is a quiet, fascinating alternative to busy art museums.

name: Reading Between the Lines
address: Wandelweg between Sint-Truidersteenweg and Heirbaan, 3840 Tongeren-Borgloon, Limburg
notes: This ten-metre steel church appears solid from one angle and dissolves into the landscape from another. Reach it by a short countryside walk or include it in a Haspengouw e-bike route with fruit orchards and other outdoor artworks.

name: Rocher de Bayard
notes: A spectacular 40-meter high needle of rock standing alone next to the Meuse river, with the road passing right through a narrow cleft. Legend says it was split by the hoof of a giant magic horse. A quick but wildly photogenic stop when driving the area.

name: Route des Crêtes de l'Ardenne
notes: A gorgeous scenic drive winding through the valleys and peaks of the Ardennes. It is perfect for a road trip in the truck and provides access to countless hiking and camping spots. Highlights the rugged natural beauty of eastern Belgium.

name: Semois Valley Route
address: Rue de la Cense, 6830 Rochehaut, Luxembourg
notes: Drive the winding roads between Bouillon, Rochehaut, Frahan and Vresse-sur-Semois, stopping for river-bend viewpoints and short hikes. The F-150 will fit on the main roads but village streets and parking can be tight, so use the e-bikes for local exploration and camp only at designated sites.

name: Stadsbrouwerij De Koninck
notes: An interactive, self-guided brewery experience in Antwerp that is modern and highly engaging. Visitors learn the history of the iconic Bolleke glass and enjoy tastings along the route. The site also hosts independent food artisans like a cheese shop and bakery.

name: The Owl Distillery
notes: A fascinating tour of a working distillery producing award-winning Belgian single malt whisky. It uses local barley and authentic Scottish stills in a charming agricultural setting. Offers a premium tasting experience perfect for craft beverage lovers.

name: Tower of Eben-Ezer
notes: This eccentric flint tower was built by one man as a symbolic, biblical and philosophical monument. The museum is delightfully difficult to classify, and it combines well with Fort Eben-Emael, Maastricht or cycling beside the Albert Canal.

name: Train World
notes: A beautifully designed railway museum housed in the old Schaerbeek train station. It showcases spectacular historic locomotives in dramatic lighting, offering a surprisingly captivating experience even for non-enthusiasts. Easy to reach via public transit in Brussels.

name: Vennbahn Cycle Route
notes: This largely traffic-free rail trail runs through Belgium, Germany and Luxembourg with gentle gradients ideal for foldable e-bikes. Ride a one-way stage and arrange a shuttle or choose an out-and-back section from Sankt Vith; campsites and cafés make multi-day riding straightforward.

name: Verbeke Foundation
notes: A former transport depot houses bio-art, industrial installations and gloriously strange experiments rather than a polished conventional museum. Allow several hours, wear practical shoes and combine it with Doel or Antwerp's port landscape.

name: Villers Abbey
address: Rue de l'Abbaye 55, 1495 Villers-la-Ville, Walloon Brabant
notes: These vast Cistercian ruins offer vaulted remains, gardens and atmospheric paths without requiring a full-day museum commitment. Explore for roughly two hours, then continue to Waterloo or cycle quiet roads through the surrounding countryside.

name: Waterloo 1815 Memorial
address: Route du Lion 1815, 1420 Braine-l'Alleud, Walloon Brabant
notes: The battlefield complex includes an underground museum, panoramic presentation, Hougoumont Farm and the Lion's Mound. Expect substantial walking and many stairs if climbing the mound, and combine it with Villers Abbey or Hallerbos.

name: Zwin Nature Park
address: Graaf Léon Lippensdreef 8, 8300 Knokke-Heist, West Flanders
notes: This coastal reserve combines salt marshes, bird hides, observation points and easy trails near the Dutch border. Park outside the busiest coastal zone when possible and approach by e-bike; migration seasons pair well with a ride through the Zwin polders.

name: 3-Mile Beach Clothing Optional - Penticton
address: Okanagan Lake N, Penticton, BC V2A
notes: Clothing-optional beach on the shore of Okanagan Lake! Naturist destination for decades. Penticton, Okanagan Valley. FREE. Goldbug style, but by a lake. Okanagan: also wine country! Combine naturist + winery.

name: 33 Acres Brewing - Vancouver
notes: Vancouver's most aesthetically perfect microbrewery! 33 Acres of Darkness + Ocean are the iconic beers. Mount Pleasant, Vancouver. White & sleek interior. Coffee culture + beer culture combined. Instagram-perfect taproom.

name: Araxi - Whistler
notes: Whistler's #1 restaurant - James Beard-nominated chef James Walt! Oysters + farm-to-table Pacific Northwest. Village Square, Whistler. House fondue after skiing = Belgian dream. Book well in advance.

name: Barkerville Ghost Town
notes: BC's biggest gold rush town – restored into a living museum! Costume demonstrations. Gold panning. 100+ buildings. Barkerville, N-Cariboo region. Far from everything. May-September. One of Canada's best-preserved ghost towns.

name: Boswell Embalming Bottle House
notes: House built from 500,000 wrapped embalming fluid bottles! David H. Brown built this in 1952-1953 using bottles from his own funeral business. Boswell, Kootenay Lake shore. FREE to view from the outside. One of the most bizarre buildings in Canada.

name: Britannia Mine Museum
notes: Former largest copper mine of the British Empire - now a museum! X-Files was filmed here! Real mine train into the mountain. Explosion demonstrations. Britannia Beach, Sea-to-Sky Highway. Perfect stop on the way to Whistler.

name: Capilano Suspension Bridge - Vancouver
address: 3735 Capilano Rd, North Vancouver, BC V7R 4J1
notes: 137m suspension bridge over a 70m deep gorge! Treetops Adventure: 7 suspension bridges between 300-year-old cedar trees. North Vancouver. Open all year round. Expensive but includes a Cliffwalk along the cliffs. Best family day out in Vancouver.

name: Club Eden Vancouver
notes: Vancouver lifestyle club via Kasidie ​​+ own events! Various locations throughout the year. Couples and select singles. Via Kasidie.com and Club Eden website. Vancouple has an active lifestyle scene.

name: Fairmont Chateau Whistler
notes: Iconic ski chateau at the foot of Blackcomb Mountain! Ski-in ski-out (Blackcomb side). Spa. Multiple restaurants. Whistler Upper Village. High season: expensive but impressive. Ikon Pass: slopes are literally right on the doorstep.

name: FlyOver Canada - Vancouver
notes: Simulated flying experience over Canada's landscapes! 4D cinema: scent, wind, and movement as you fly over Canada. Canada Place, Vancouver waterfront. Perfect intro for a Canada road trip! Kids will go wild.

name: Garibaldi PP - Panorama Ridge
address: Rubble Creek Trailhead, Squamish, BC V0N 1H0
notes: Garibaldi Lake = the most photographed place in BC! Turquoise-blue glacial lake surrounded by volcanic peaks. Panorama Ridge offers a breathtaking 360° view. 30 km round trip, but WOW. Book backcountry camping well in advance via bcparks.ca - it sells out lightning fast.

name: Gastown Steam Clock - Vancouver
address: Water St & Cambie St, Vancouver, BC V6B 1A5
notes: Steam-powered clock that whistles every quarter hour! Gastown, Vancouver's oldest neighborhood (1867). FREE. Water Street. Touristy but authentic steam mechanism. Surrounded by Vancouver's best restaurants.

name: Goats on the Roof - Coombs
notes: GOATS on the grass roof of a market hall! Really. Real goats. Old Country Market: with grazing goats on the roof for over 50 years. May-October: Pip and Penny doing their thing. Coombs, Vancouver Island, 44 km from Nanaimo. FREE to see. Market full of European delicacies inside. A must-see!

name: Helmcken Falls - Wells Gray PP
address: Wells Gray Park Rd, Clearwater, BC V0E 1N0
notes: 4th highest waterfall in Canada - 141m free fall, HIGHER than Niagara! Wells Gray PP = BC's most underrated park with 200+ waterfalls, lava fields, and volcanic craters. Almost no tourists compared to Banff. 500 km north of Vancouver. FREE. Absolutely impressive.

name: Icefields Pkwy BC kant - Yoho National Park
notes: Spiral Tunnels + Emerald Lake + Takakkaw Falls in one park! Takakkaw: Canada's 2nd highest waterfall (373m). Field, BC. Parks Canada pass valid. Via Trans-Canada Highway from Alberta to BC. Less visited than Banff but just as spectacular.

name: Joe Fortes Seafood - Vancouver
notes: Vancouver's most famous oyster bar – for 40 years! Rooftop patio + raw bar. BC Dungeness crab in season. Robson & Thurlow, Vancouver West End. Named after the real Joe Fortes: city hero and 1900s swimming instructor. Reserve. Oyster hour: best deal in town.

name: Joffre Lakes Provincial Park
address: Duffey Lake Rd, Pemberton, BC V0N 2L0
notes: BC's most spectacular day trip! 3 turquoise glacial lakes at increasingly higher altitudes – each lake more beautiful than the last. 11 km round trip, 370m elevation. START EARLY (before 8 am) – parking full by 10 am in summer. Book day pass via bcparks.ca. 2 hours from Vancouver towards Whistler.

name: Myra Canyon Trestle Trail - Kelowna
address: Myra Forest Service Rd, Kelowna, BC
notes: Spectacular historic railway bridge trail through Myra Canyon - 18 wooden trestles and 2 tunnels high above the Okanagan Valley. Cycling or walking (12 km return). FREE. Okanagan wine region right next door: 40+ vineyards! F-150 with e-bikes = perfect here. Come for the e-bike tour.

name: Ogopogo Monster - Okanagan Lake
notes: Canada's 'Loch Ness Monster' - reports for centuries! Ogopogo: Syilx First Nations described it long before Europeans. Peachland + Kelowna lake shore. Statues. FREE photo. Look closely at the water. No one has actually seen it. But still.

name: Rambo Statue - Hope
notes: Life-size bronze Rambo statue – the movie was filmed here! First Blood (1982) uses Hope as a location. Hope, Fraser Canyon. FREE. City Park. More Rambo sculptures scattered throughout the town. Scavenger hunt!

name: Revelstoke Mountain Resort ⛷️ Ikon
notes: Ikon Pass: 5 DAYS. Canada's DEEPEST powder snow + GREATEST vertical elevation in the world (1,713m)! Small, authentic ski town. Expert resort - Serge BUCKET LIST! Els: limited beginner options. Beautiful on the way via the Trans-Canada Hwy to Calgary. Revelstoke town itself is also an interesting stop in the summer - rafting, mountain biking!

name: Sea-to-Sky Highway (Hwy 99) - Vancouver naar Whistler
notes: One of the most beautiful coastal mountain drives in the world! Howe Sound, fjords, Britannia Beach, Squamish, Shannon Falls. 120 km. Chief (2nd largest monolith in the world) visible. FREE road. Squamish: climbing capital of Canada. Fjord + mountain peaks + estuary: completely surreal.

name: Stawamus Chief - Squamish
address: 1000 Stawamus Chief PP, Squamish, BC V8B 0N7
notes: Canada's largest granite monolith – a 700m high cliff face with 3 peaks, each offering a spectacular panorama over Howe Sound! Climbing capital of Canada. Tough hike but enormous reward. FREE. 1 hour from Vancouver on the Sea-to-Sky Highway. Combine with Garibaldi.

name: Sutton Place Hotel - Vancouver
notes: Classic elegant hotel in the heart of Vancouver! Burrard Street, walkable to everything. Classic European interior. Good service. Vancouver city center. Close to Joe Fortes. Reliable and central.

name: Tacofino - Vancouver
notes: Vancouver's iconic Tofino-born taco truck - now restaurants! Baja-style fish tacos with a Pacific Northwest twist. Multiple locations in Vancouver + original Tofino food truck. Best casual food in town. Vistaco Serge: this isn't Belgium, but it's close.

name: Terex Titan - Sparwood
notes: The BIGGEST mining truck in the world - Titan! 350-ton capacity. 20 meters tall. Parks right in the city. Sparwood, SE British Columbia. FREE. Photo stop along Hwy 3. Where else does a dump truck stand as a city landmark?

name: The Enchanted Forest - Malakwa
notes: 350+ fairytale characters hidden among 800-year-old cedar trees! A Canadian roadside classic for over 60 years. Malakwa, near Revelstoke, Trans-Canada Highway. May-September. Children: overwhelmed. Adults: nostalgic overdose.

name: The Keg Steakhouse - Whistler
notes: Canada's beloved steakhouse in the historic Telus World of Ski building! Alberta beef in a ski-lodge setting. Mountain Square, Whistler. Not fancy but consistent and tasty. Post-ski steak = Canadian ritual.

name: Van Tan Club - North Vancouver
notes: Canada's OLDEST naturist club (1939) - families and couples! Upper Lynn Valley, next to Mount Fromme. Pool, grounds, social area. North Vancouver. Summer months. Contact via website for a trial visit.

name: Vancouver Island - Pacific Rim / Tofino
notes: Wild Pacific coast with storm waves + surfers + old growth! Long Beach: 10 km wild sandy beach. Pacific Rim NP. March Storm Watching: waves 10m high. Tofino: 2 hours from Nanaimo via Coombs (goats!). May-Sept: mild. Winter: dramatic storm season.

name: Whistler Blackcomb
notes: IKON PASS: unlimited! North America's most visited ski resort! 8,171 acres. 2 mountains. 200+ slopes. Whistler Village: charming pedestrian-only center. Pheasant + gondola connection between the mountains. June 2027 (Phase 2): gondola + Peak 2 Peak in summer!

name: Whistler Blackcomb ⛷️ Ikon
notes: Ikon Pass: 5 DAYS. LARGEST ski area in North America! 8,171 acres, 200+ runs. Peak 2 Peak Gondola = world record gondola over two mountain peaks (epic vlog content!). Whistler Village = lively, world-class restaurants, après-ski scene. Els: Village zone + Harmony Chairs = good beginner areas. Serge: Blackcomb bowls and Spanky's Ladder = epic. NOTE: book Ikon days EARLY - blackout periods!

name: Whistler Brewing Company
address: 1209 Alpha Lake Rd, Whistler, BC V0N 1B1
notes: Whistler's own craft brewery by the lake! Powder Mountain Lager + Gnarlywhiner White IPA. Functionhouse Road, Whistler. Taproom + tours. Since 1989. Local legend. Post-ski pint here = Whistler ritual.

name: Whistler Helicopter Tours
notes: Helicopter over Whistler Blackcomb + glacier + fjords! Blacktusk, Garibaldi Lake, Coast Mountains from above. Whistler. Summer and winter. Glacier landing option available! Content for @roamingbonbons that you won't find anywhere else.

name: Wild Blue - Whistler
notes: #2 Best New Restaurant Canada 2023 + #31 Canada's 100 Best! Chef Alex Chen (Iron Chef winner). Pacific Northwest seafood. Whistler Village. Most talked-about restaurant in Whistler now. Book months in advance.

name: Wreck Beach - Vancouver
address: Trail 6 off Marine Dr, Vancouver, BC V6T 1Z4
notes: North America's LARGEST clothing-optional beach - 7.8 km! UBC Pacific Spirit Park. Legal nude beach. Vendors, music, party atmosphere on weekends. Vancouver, SW. Stair 4 down from Marine Drive. Summer: warm enough. Goldbug of the Pacific Coast.

name: 826LA & Time Travel Mart (Echo Park)
address: 1714 W Sunset Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90026
notes: Shop for time travelers: mammoth chunks and robot milk! Real writing school hidden behind the shelves. Echo Park – funny, clever, and completely surreal. Buy souvenirs 'for a trip to the future'.

name: Aerobatische vlucht (Art of Flight)
address: French Valley Airport, 37600 Sky Canyon Dr, Murrieta, CA 92563
notes: Aerobatic loops over Los Angeles! Barrel rolls, hammerheads, and freefall maneuvers. Various packages - from 30 to 60 min. SERGE BUCKET LIST - an absolute must!

name: Alabama Hills (filmlocatie)
notes: Film location for 400+ Westerns, Star Trek, and Gladiator! Arch rock formations with the Sierra Nevada as a backdrop. BLM land = completely free admission. The golden hour here is literally MAGICAL.

name: Albert's (San Diego Zoo)
notes: Restaurant in the middle of the San Diego Zoo! Eat while flamingos walk around. Surprisingly good quality for a zoo. Only if you're visiting the zoo anyway.

name: Ancient Bristlecone Pine Forest
notes: Oldest living trees in the world - some MORE THAN 5,000 YEARS OLD! Older than the Egyptian pyramids. Methuselah Tree (4,850 years old) stands here - location secret. White Mountains at an altitude of 3,000m. Incredible twisted sculptures. $6 day pass. Accessible via Bishop.

name: Anza-Borrego Metal Sculptures
notes: 130+ life-size metal sculptures in the desert! Dragons, mammoths, snakes - ALL FREE. Ricardo Breceda's work spread over miles. Go in winter - summer is literally 45°C.

name: Artist's Palette - Death Valley
notes: Psychedelic multicolor rocks due to metal oxides in the rock – red, pink, yellow, green! Best photo opportunity: blue hour just before sunrise or after sunset. Set your white balance to cool. America the Beautiful valid. 9 miles one-way traffic via Artist's Drive.

name: Balboa Park (San Diego)
notes: 1,200-acre park with 17 museums and beautiful gardens! Spanish colonial architecture = free photo paradise. Botanic garden free, museums paid separately. San Diego Zoo here too - America the Beautiful pass.

name: Black's Beach (San Diego)
notes: San Diego's famous nude beach! Steep path down - 15-minute walk. Unofficial but legally tolerated. Quiet and beautiful off-weekend.

name: Bodie State Historic Park
notes: The most intact ghost town in the US! 1878 gold mining town – simply abandoned, never cleaned up. Cars, decks of cards, bottles – everything is still there. Road can be rough – 4x4 recommended!

name: Bonny Doon Beach (Santa Cruz)
address: Bonny Doon Rd, Santa Cruz, CA 95060
notes: Informal naturist beach near Santa Cruz. Secluded location = quiet and pristine. Pacific water = cold but refreshing. Combine with an overnight stay at the Pinecone Treehouse!

name: Bowling Ball Beach
notes: Perfect round stones on the beach! Naturally formed by millions of years of erosion. Near Gualala on the Mendocino coast. Low tide required - check a tide table in advance.

name: Bradbury Building (Downtown LA)
notes: Victorian interior with glass and cast iron (1893). Film location for Blade Runner and 500 Days of Summer. Ground floor free to visit. Quietest and most beautiful spot in downtown LA.

name: Bubblegum Alley (San Luis Obispo)
address: 733 Higuera St, San Luis Obispo, CA 93401
notes: 70 feet of alley covered in chewing gum since the 1950s! Nobody knows why it started. Mandatory: stop and stick one on yourself. Do NOT look too closely at the older layers.

name: Calico Ghost Town
notes: 1880s silver mining ghost town near Barstow. Partially restored - more touristy than Bodie. Near I-15 - perfect stopover on the way to Vegas. Includes gold panning activity.

name: Canter's Deli (Fairfax)
address: 419 N Fairfax Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90036
notes: Jewish-American deli since 1931. Open 24/7 – even at 3 AM after a night in LA. Matzah ball soup and pastrami sandwich. Fairfax district = Jewish neighborhood, real atmosphere.

name: Carlsbad Flower Fields (maart-mei!)
notes: 50 acres of ranunculus in full bloom - WOW! ONLY open March-May - timing is everything. Absolutely stunning photographically. Els really won't put the camera down here!

name: Chicken Pie Shop (San Diego)
address: 2633 El Cajon Blvd, San Diego, CA 92104
notes: San Diego institution since 1938! Homemade chicken pot pie for $8. Simple, authentic, incredibly priced. San Diego grandparents' favorite spot.

name: Corvette Diner (San Diego)
address: 2965 Historic Decatur Rd, San Diego, CA 92106
notes: 1950s diner with real Corvettes on the wall! Retro jukebox, milkshakes, hamburgers. Magicians and DJs on weekends. Part of the Fleet Science Center complex.

name: Crowley Lake Columns
address: Crowley Lake Dr, Mammoth Lakes, CA 93546
notes: Secret basalt columns half-submerged in a mountain lake! Best time: late summer when they protrude above the water. Accessible via 4x4 track, 4-mile hike, or boat. 30 min from Mammoth. Sunset is magical.

name: Cypress Tree Tunnel - Point Reyes
address: 17400 Sir Francis Drake Blvd, Inverness, CA 94937
notes: Iconic double row of California cypresses along the access road to the historic Pierce Ranch. Magical light approximately 1 hour after sunrise – stand at the SIDE of the building for beams of light through the trees. FREE. Different entrance from the main Point Reyes park.

name: DC-9 Tandem Jump (Skydive Perris)
notes: Tandem jump from a DC-9 JET! The only place in the world for jet tandem skydiving. Highest jump = longest free fall of your life. BUCKET LIST for Serge - book well in advance!

name: Death Valley National Park
notes: Lowest point in North America (-86m)! Badwater Basin, Mesquite Dunes, Artist's Palette. America the Beautiful Pass valid! GO IN WINTER ONLY - summer is deadly serious.

name: Devil's Postpile National Monument
address: Minaret Summit Rd, Mammoth Lakes, CA 93546
notes: Perfect basalt columns ABOVE the ground – same phenomenon as Crowley Lake but vertical! Plus Rainbow Falls (30m) nearby on the same trail. Road open mid-June to mid-October. Mandatory shuttle from Mammoth Mountain Main Lodge ($10). Hike to the TOP for a view of polished column tops.

name: El Coyote (Beverly Blvd)
notes: Cheap margaritas, open since 1931. Sharon Tate's very last diner (August 1969). Dark, kitsch Mexican interior. Unpretentious LA classic.

name: Griffith Observatory
address: 2800 E Observatory Rd, Los Angeles, CA 90027
notes: Best free view of all of Los Angeles! Telescopes free to use in the evening. Filming location for Rebel Without a Cause. Book planetarium show in advance ($10 extra).

name: Hodad's (Ocean Beach)
notes: Surf-themed burger joint full of license plates! Best burgers in San Diego - no discussion. Huge portions, cash preferred. Real Ocean Beach surf town experience.

name: Hollywood Forever Cemetery
address: 6000 Santa Monica Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90038
notes: Graves of Valentino, Cecil B. DeMille, Johnny Ramone. Summer: films projected onto the mausoleum. Peacocks roam freely! The weirdest and most beautiful cemetery in the US.

name: Idle Hour (North Hollywood)
notes: Bar built like a GIGANTIC beer barrel (1941)! Programmatic architecture - the building IS the advertisement. Classic cocktail and whiskey collection. One of the weirdest buildings in all of LA.

name: Integratron (Landers)
notes: Dome built by alien contactee Van Tassel. Acoustically perfect wooden dome without nails. Sound bath meditation sessions = surreal. Near Joshua Tree - perfect day combo!

name: June Mountain ⛷️ Ikon
notes: Ikon Pass: UNLIMITED. Little brother of Mammoth, a 20-minute drive away. Quieter and less crowded. Good as a day trip from Mammoth Lakes for variety. Not the best terrain, but the June Lake village is picturesque. Spring skiing possible until April.

name: Kansas City Barbecue (San Diego)
address: 600 W Harbor Dr, San Diego, CA 92101
notes: Top Gun bar – this is where the bar scenes were filmed! Raw wooden walls full of movie memorabilia. Best BBQ ribs in San Diego according to locals. Live music Friday and Saturday.

name: Knott's Berry Farm
notes: America's oldest theme park (1920s)! Now part of Six Flags - Prestige Pass valid! Ghost Town theme = great photos. Berry preserves and fried chicken are iconic.

name: La Jolla Cove (zeeleeuwen)
notes: Sea lions and seals right on the beach! Snorkeling with leopard sharks (harmless, promised). Cliff path with spectacular Pacific views. Park early – it gets busy and paid parking later.

name: Laguna del Sol (Naturist Resort)
notes: AANR-certified naturist resort near Sacramento! Lagoons, pools, spa, and a good restaurant. Clothing-optional, 18+, member of AANR. One of the very best naturist resorts in the US!

name: Lassen Volcanic National Park
notes: ACTIVE volcano with boiling mud pools! America's most underrated National Park. Hydrothermal features rival Yellowstone. America the Beautiful Pass valid - snow until July!

name: Madonna Inn
address: 100 Madonna Road, San Luis Obispo, CA 93405
notes: 110 UNIQUE themed rooms, each completely different! From Cave Man to Love Nest to Swiss Belle. Best Instagram stop on the CA coast. Book months in advance - always fully booked!

name: Mammoth Mountain ⛷️ Ikon
notes: Ikon Pass: UNLIMITED. PERFECT spring skiing! April/May season = soft snow, warm sun, forgiving falls for Els. Festival atmosphere in the village. Morning skiing, afternoon relaxation by the lake. Combines with Whitmore Hot Springs (on the outbound/return journey). PLAN MULTIPLE DAYS - absolute highlight of the California road trip. Sometimes open until June!

name: Mono Lake Tufa Towers
notes: Alien limestone towers rise from the lake! Once protected via a historic lawsuit vs. LA. 1 million birds stop here every year. Early morning = mirror-smooth water = EPIC photo.

name: Monterey Bay Aquarium
notes: One of the best aquariums in the world! The jellyfish exhibit is simply mesmerizing. Sea otter feeding is an absolute must-see. Book in advance – lines are long in summer.

name: More Mesa Beach (Santa Barbara)
address: More Mesa Dr, Santa Barbara, CA 93117
notes: Santa Barbara's unofficial naturist beach. Flat walk through wetlands - easy. Quiet and local-friendly atmosphere. Perfect warm climate in the summer.

name: Museum of Jurassic Technology (Culver City)
notes: No dinosaurs – complete NEPSEUM! Exhibits sound real but are made up. Meta-art about what museums actually mean. The most confusing 2 hours in all of LA.

name: Musso & Frank Grill (Hollywood)
notes: Hollywood's oldest restaurant, open since 1919! Charlie Chaplin, Hemingway, and Tarantino ate here. Famous martinis and classic steaks. Reserve or wait a long time—but worth it!

name: Mystery Spot (Santa Cruz)
address: 465 Mystery Spot Rd, Santa Cruz, CA 95065
notes: Gravity does NOT work normally here! Balls roll up, people stand at an angle. Skeptics can't believe their own eyes. Classic roadside attraction – definitely do it!

name: Neptune's Net (Malibu)
notes: Legendary seafood shack on the PCH! Loved by surfers and motorcyclists alike. Fresh clam chowder, crab, and lobster by the ocean. Perfect after a day at Malibu beach.

name: Old Town San Diego
notes: Oldest Californian settlement (1769). Mexican restaurants and craft market. Día de los Muertos celebrations are spectacular. Free walking tours available daily.

name: Painted Dunes + Cinder Cone - Lassen
address: Butte Lake Trailhead, Lassen Volcanic NP, CA 96063
notes: Amazing pastel-colored lava fragments next to the black Cinder Cone volcano. Evening light or the blue hour gives the best result. Adjust your white balance in full sun. 4 miles round trip. America the Beautiful valid. Specific hike within Lassen – different from the general park entrance.

name: Philippe The Original (Downtown LA)
address: 1001 N Alameda St, Los Angeles, CA 90012
notes: Inventors of the French Dip sandwich (1908)! Sawdust on the floor, communal counters. Cash only, line at the counter - LA legend for $10. Open daily 6am - also for breakfast.

name: Pinecone Treehouse (Bonny Doon)
address: Bonny Doon, CA (exact adres via Airbnb)
notes: Unique treehouse Airbnb in Redwood Forest. Near Santa Cruz - perfect base location. Romantic and secluded. Combine with Bonny Doon naturist beach!

name: Pink's Hot Dogs (Hollywood)
address: 709 N La Brea Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90038
notes: LA's most famous hot dog stand since 1939! 60+ types of hot dogs with celebrity names. The line is part of the experience. Try the Mulholland Drive Dog.

name: Pirate's Cove (Avila Beach)
address: Cave Landing Rd, Avila Beach, CA 93424
notes: Sheltered naturist beach on the Central Coast! Warmest seawater on the CA coast - rare! Near Avila Beach and San Luis Obispo. Accessible via a 15-minute walk.

name: Point Reyes National Seashore
notes: Spectacular coastline north of SF. Tule elk roam freely here – a guaranteed photo. Lighthouse: 308 steps down the cliff. Can be extremely foggy – that is beautiful too!

name: Post Ranch Inn (Big Sur)
notes: Ultra-luxury on a cliff overlooking the Pacific Ocean. $800-1200+/night - way out of budget. Perfect for a VERY special night. Only consider as a one-time splurge.

name: Queen Califia's Magical Circle
notes: Niki de Saint Phalle Sculpture Park! Colorful mosaic snakes and mystical figures. Free in Kit Carson Park, Escondido. Check opening hours - not open every day.

name: Queen Mary (Long Beach)
notes: Sleep on a historic ocean steamship! Art Deco interiors from the 1930s. Haunted tours available. Long Beach skyline from the deck at night.

name: Randy's Donuts (Inglewood)
notes: GIGANTIC donut on the roof since 1952! Absolute LA icon - on dozens of movie posters. Perfect road trip photo stop. Just grab a donut there too - they're delicious!

name: Red Rock Canyon State Park - CA
notes: Surprisingly Utah-style red rocks and hoodoos in the middle of the California desert! Colorful cliffs, buttes, and volcanic rock. Famous movie location. Almost no tourists. Free campsites available. $8 day pass. Perfect stopover on the way to LA or Death Valley.

name: Salvation Mountain
notes: Psychedelic mountain of paint and adobe! Built by Leonard Knight as a gift to God. Declared a national art treasure. Near Salton Sea – perfect day trip combination.

name: Sea Mountain Inn Lifestyles Resort
notes: Adults-only lifestyle resort in Desert Hot Springs. Clothing-optional pools and mineral water spa. Lifestyle events regularly on the agenda. Membership required - check website in advance.

name: Sequoia National Park
notes: General Sherman = largest living tree in the world! Tunnel Log: drive through a fallen tree. America the Beautiful Pass valid. Combination with Kings Canyon for a full day.

name: Six Flags Magic Mountain
notes: 20 roller coasters - the most in the world at one park! INCLUDED with Six Flags Prestige Pass! Superman, Twisted Colossus, X2 = insane. Weekdays are less busy.

name: The Apple Pan (West LA)
address: 10801 W Pico Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90064
notes: U-shaped counter, no tables - since 1947! NOTHING has changed in 75 years. That is the point. Famous Hickory Burger and cream pie. Cash only - but dirt cheap and authentic.

name: The Last Bookstore (Downtown LA)
address: 453 S Spring St, Los Angeles, CA 90013
notes: Book tunnel of thousands of stacked books! Instagram-famous spiral bookshelves. Also vinyl records and art on the upper floor. CA's largest used bookstore - free.

name: The Ultimate Luxury Tantra Experience
notes: Luxury tantra workshops and retreats near LA. For experienced couples with an open attitude. Various packages and dates available. Website for rates and registration.

name: Trailer Park After Dark (Gaslamp)
notes: Bar/restaurant designed like a fake trailer park! Kitschy American decor taken to the extreme. Burgers, BBQ, and craft cocktails. San Diego's most Instagram-worthy bar.

name: Treebones Resort (Big Sur)
notes: Glamping yurts on a cliff above the ocean. More affordable than Post Ranch, just as spectacular. The Human Nest tree pod is iconic. Book well in advance – maximum 16 units!

name: Trees of Mystery (Klamath)
notes: 49-foot-tall Paul Bunyan welcomes you! Cable car ride over the redwood forest treetops. Native American museum included. Authentic Northern California roadside kitsch – MUST DO!

name: Trona Pinnacles
notes: Alien tufa pinnacles in the middle of the Mojave Desert – 500+ limestone points up to 140 feet high, 40,000 years old! Film location (Star Trek V, Battlestar Galactica). At night: perfect dark sky location for astrophotography. FREE, no facilities – bring water.

name: USS Midway Museum (San Diego)
address: 910 N Harbor Dr, San Diego, CA 92101
notes: Largest WWII-era aircraft carrier museum in the world! 30+ historic aircraft to admire on deck. Cockpit simulators available. Serge Paradise: allow at least half a day!

name: Venice Beach Boardwalk
notes: LA's biggest freak show – completely free! Bodybuilders, street performers, and psychics. Muscle Beach outdoor gym is legendary. Morning or evening – it gets busy during the day.

name: Watts Towers (South LA)
notes: Built solely by Simon Rodia over 33 years. Towers of bottles, shells, and tiles. National Monument + UNESCO candidate. Surprisingly beautiful for a 'crazy guy project'!

name: Whitmore Hot Springs (Mammoth)
address: Benton Crossing Rd, Mammoth Lakes, CA 93546
notes: Outdoor geothermal pool in the Sierras! Loved by locals – no tourists. Near Mammoth Lakes and June Lake. Perfect after a day of skiing or hiking.

name: Wigwam Motel (Rialto)
notes: Sleep in a concrete wigwam! One of the last Route 66 icons. Kitschy vintage Americana at its best. Original 1940s concrete teepees - 7 still intact.

name: Winchester Mystery House (San Jose)
address: 525 S Winchester Blvd, San Jose, CA 95128
notes: 160 rooms built by a weapons manufacturer's widow! Stairs to the ceiling, doors to the void. Sarah Winchester built non-stop for 38 years. One of the WEIRDEST buildings on Earth.

name: Yosemite Firefall - Horsetail Fall
address: El Capitan Meadow, Yosemite Valley, CA 95389
notes: Horsetail Fall lights up like liquid fire – but ONLY in the second half of February when snowmelt and perfect sunlight combine. It looks absolutely otherworldly. Strict security during this event. Book well in advance. Phase 1 of your trip – PERFECT timing!

name: Animas Forks Ghost Town
notes: 11,200ft elevation ghost town!  4WD required.  Mining ruins spectacular.  Snow-free only Jun-Sep.  REMOTE adventure!

name: Argo Mill and Tunnel
notes: GOLD mine tour!  Walk into 1913 mine.  Pan for gold.  Mining history.  Idaho Springs!

name: Aspen Snowmass + Buttermilk ⛷️ Ikon
notes: Ikon Pass: 7 DAYS (Snowmass). Buttermilk = BEST beginner mountain in all of North America! At this point in the trip, Els will excel here. MAX the 7 Ikon days here. BUDGET TIP: stay in Carbondale or Glenwood Springs (30-45 min) - Aspen itself = astronomically expensive. Snowmass Village = more budget-friendly alternative. Historic X-Games location. Serge: Aspen Mountain + Highland Bowl = epic. Final sprint of the ski season!

name: Best Western Movie Manor
notes: DRIVE-IN from your bed!  Room face outdoor screen.  Watch movies in pajamas.  Summer movies nightly.  UNIQUE concept!

name: Bishop Castle
notes: ONE-MAN castle! Built over 50+ years by Jim Bishop. Iron + stone sculpture. Climb the towers (at your own risk!). FREE. BIZARRE!

name: Buckhorn Exchange
notes: Denver's OLDEST restaurant (1893)!  Wild game: elk, buffalo, rattlesnake.  500+ animal trophies.  Colorado liquor license #1!  OLD WEST atmosphere!

name: Cano's Castle
notes: Beer can castle! Donald "Cano" Espinoza's artwork. Thousands of cans. Roadside art. FREE viewpoint!

name: Casa Bonita
notes: SOUTH PARK fame restaurant!  Cliff diverse, arcade, Black Bart's Cave.  Mexican food (quantity > quality).  Trey Parker/Matt Stone rescued it.  KITSCH paradise!

name: Cave of the Winds Mountain Park
address: 100 Cave of the Winds Rd, Manitou Springs CO 80829
notes: GUIDED cave tours!  Dark + lantern tours.  TerraDactyl ride.  Wind Walker Challenge Course.  FAMILY adventure!

name: Chapel on the Rock
notes: STONE chapel on a rock! Built in 1936. Rocky Mountains backdrop. Popular wedding spot. FREE. Instagram worthy!

name: Colorado Gators Reptile Park
notes: GATORS in Colorado!  Geothermal water farm.  350+ alligators.  Hold baby gator ($10).  WTF factor high!

name: Copper Mountain Resort ⛷️ Ikon
notes: Ikon Pass: UNLIMITED. BEST beginner setup in Colorado! West Village = 100% beginner-only zone. Experts do NOT drive through it. Els can practice completely freely and undisturbed. Multi-day stop on I-70. Stay in Frisco or Silverthorne (cheaper). DISADVANTAGE: I-70 weekend traffic is a notorious nightmare - leave early on Friday/Saturday.

name: Cosmo's Magic Theater
address: 1045 Garden of the Gods Rd, Colorado Springs, CO 80907
notes: INTIMATE magic shows!  50-seat theater.  Close up illusions.  Maniton Springs charm.  FUN family night!

name: Denver Art Museum
notes: MODERN architecture (Daniel Libeskind)!  Native American art.  70,000 works.  Free days available.  CULTURAL gem!

name: Eldora Mountain Resort ⛷️ Ikon
notes: Ikon Pass: UNLIMITED. Advice: SKIP unless you want to visit Boulder! NOTORIOUS for extreme wind and ice formation – makes it an unpleasant learning experience for Els. Close to Boulder (the town is worth a day trip). Not recommended as a standalone ski day. If you do go: take the earliest tram before the wind picks up.

name: Estes Park Aerial Tramway
address: 420 E Riverside Dr, Estes Park CO 80517
notes: AERIAL tram 8,896ft!  Panoramic views.  Short ride (4 minutes).  Rocky Mountain overlook.  Summer only!

name: Garden of the Gods
notes: RED ROCK formations!  FREE city park.  Balancing Rock, Kissing Camels.  Rock climbing.  Pikes Peak backdrop. STUNNING!

name: Glenwood Hot Springs Pool
address: 401 N River St, Glenwood Springs, CO 81601
notes: LARGEST hot springs pool! 2 blocks long. 90-104°F. Water slide! Year-round outdoor swimming!

name: Great Sand Dunes National Park
notes: TALLEST sand dunes North America!  750ft high.  Medano Creek (seasonal).  Sandboarding!  SURREAL landscape!

name: Helen Hunt Falls
address: N Cheyenne Canyon Rd, Colorado Springs CO 80906
notes: 35-foot waterfall!  Short easy trail.  Visitor centre.  Cheyenne Canyon.  FREE quick stop!

name: Iron Mountain Hot Springs
notes: 16 POOLS different temps!  98-108°F.  Colorado River views.  Modern facility.  Glenwood Springs!

name: Kebler Pass (Aspen)
address: Kebler Pass Rd, tussen Crested Butte en Paonia CO
notes: LARGEST aspen grove North America!  Fall colors SPECTACULAR.  Unpaved 30 miles.  Photography paradise.  Sep-Oct PEAK!

name: May Natural History Museum
address: 710 Rock Creek Canyon Rd, Colorado Springs, CO 80926
notes: INSECT museum!  8,000+ specimens.  Giant bugs from around the world.  Hercules beetles.  Creepy crawly heaven!

name: Meow Wolf's Convergence Station
notes: IMMERSIVE art experience!  4 floors psychedelic.  Interactive installations.  2+ hours needed.  MIND BENDING!

name: Mile High Stadiums
notes: BRONCOS football!  76,125 capacity.  Tours available.  Denver sports icon.  NFL experience!

name: Million Dollar Highway
address: US-550 tussen Ouray en Silverton, CO
notes: MOST scenic drive Colorado!  25 miles of switchbacks.  No guard rails!  11,000ft passes.  BREATH TAKING + scary!

name: Mountain Air Ranch
